rule.any:
Squares with green dots (in the bottom row) contain bacteria; the marked squares in the top row are GOAL squares. An Attacker and a Defender take turns. On each turn the Defender removes exactly 1 bacterium from any square of their choice. The Attacker chooses one of the following three moves:
1. Move all bacteria on one square one step left or right.
2. Move a single bacterium forward by two rows (a jump).
3. Select a square where cell division occurs: every bacterium on that square divides, and one copy moves diagonally forward-left and one copy moves diagonally forward-right.
The Attacker wins if at least one bacterium reaches a GOAL square; the Defender wins if all bacteria are removed from the board.
rule.adjacent:
Squares with green dots (in the bottom row) contain bacteria; the marked squares in the top row — which are adjacent — are GOAL squares. An Attacker and a Defender take turns. On each turn the Defender removes exactly 1 bacterium from any square of their choice. The Attacker chooses one of the following three moves:
1. Move all bacteria on one square one step left or right.
2. Move a single bacterium forward by two rows (a jump).
3. Select a square where cell division occurs: every bacterium on that square divides, and one copy moves diagonally forward-left and one copy moves diagonally forward-right.
The Attacker wins if at least one bacterium reaches a GOAL square; the Defender wins if all bacteria are removed from the board.
rule.scattered:
Squares with green dots (in the bottom row) contain bacteria; the marked squares in the top row — not necessarily adjacent — are GOAL squares. An Attacker and a Defender take turns. On each turn the Defender removes exactly 1 bacterium from any square of their choice. The Attacker chooses one of the following three moves:
1. Move all bacteria on one square one step left or right.
2. Move a single bacterium forward by two rows (a jump).
3. Select a square where cell division occurs: every bacterium on that square divides, and one copy moves diagonally forward-left and one copy moves diagonally forward-right.
The Attacker wins if at least one bacterium reaches a GOAL square; the Defender wins if all bacteria are removed from the board.

step.attacker: Click on a square with bacteria and perform one of the three possible attacks with a second valid click.
step.defender: Click on a square with bacteria to remove one bacterium from it.
